chain_words.nuance: seems likely to be true but is not yet proven
sensible and fair when judged by logic
makes the listener believe the claim
strong enough to demand attention or action
so certain that no one can argue against it

explanation: These words all describe how persuasive an argument or piece of evidence is, moving from a claim that merely seems credible to one that cannot be disputed.

usage_notes.difference: 'Convincing' means the argument makes you believe something; 'compelling' means it is so strong that it grabs attention and pushes you to respond.
